description: Record the pull request that implements a design: its URL, its `status` (draft, open, merged, closed), the design `revision` it implements, and — once you have compared the PR's rendered previews with the design — `previewMatch` {status: match|mismatch|unknown, evidence: a URL to the comparison, note}. Replaces the whole record; pass only `designId` to clear it. Writing the same record again changes nothing and wakes nobody. Needs write access to the design.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

revision.description: The design revision the PR implements.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_set_implementation
